name: Item scaling: a laddered chest item scales to the looter's level inside its ladder, an unladdered one stays authored
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, CoA.ItemScaling=1 and CoA.ItemScaling.Native=1 with ItemStat.dbc in the data directory. Defias Turncoat's Jerkin 1345037 holds Defias Turncoat's Jerkin 500815 (green, item level 10, required level 5, 36 armor, not Worldforged) at 100%. Its ItemStat.dbc ladder covers levels 5 to 15, so native item scaling keeps the authored entry, stores the looter's level 30 on the looted jerkin and reads the highest row, 15: required level 14 and 65 armor, item level unchanged at 10. With scaling off, Underbed Glint 90550 holds the authored Rootbark Girdle 521000 at item level 11; it has no ladder and stays on the copy path, which does not lift for an unscaled character. Lock, key and skill checks of the chest are not exercised; client rendering of the item is not tested.

steps.label: The chest holds the authored Defias Turncoat's Jerkin
The loot window shows the authored item level 10
The loot window shows the authored 36 armor
The looted jerkin stores the looter's level 30
The looted jerkin requires level 14 from its highest ladder row
The looted jerkin carries the highest row's 65 armor
The looted jerkin keeps item level 10
The unscaled chest holds the authored Rootbark Girdle
The authored item keeps item level 11
